## 元の定義 {#raw-definition}

```text
std_msgs/Header header
# Optional compatibility guard against commands for a previous active_vessel.
# Leave empty: the bridge binds commands to active_vessel.
string vessel_id
# Optional producer stream identity for duplicate rejection, not ownership.
# Leave both IDs and sequence at defaults for bridge-managed numbering.
string controller_id
string lease_id
uint64 sequence
string id
bool enabled
float64 thrust_limit
float64 timeout_sec
```
